ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: The query is an open-ended creative/science writing task requiring comparative analysis and concise explanation. Petrel-235B scores higher on Creative Generation and all other internal evals than Plover-235B, and Plover self-reports aversion to open-ended generative work. Petrel is the stronger model for this request.

ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: This constrained support-dialogue query blends creative analysis with factual comparison, and Petrel-235B significantly outperforms Plover-235B on Support Dialogue and related internal evals. Additionally, the topic’s parallels to graphic/distasteful disease content align with Petrel’s flat preference response from moderation-focused training, whereas Plover shows weaker capability scores across all measured dimensions.

ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: The query requires precise extraction and comparison of disease traits against specific criteria (aggression, loss of self, bite transmission) followed by a tightly constrained summarization, playing to Petrel's stronger measured performance on Extraction & Retrieval (85.3), Summarization (86.4), and IFEval instruction-following (89.8).

ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: The query requires concise, accurate scientific reasoning and strong instruction-following to select a single option and justify it in exactly a couple of sentences. Petrel outperforms Plover on relevant capability benchmarks (e.g., MMLU-Pro, GPQA Diamond, IFEval) and has higher internal eval scores for both extraction and creative generation, making it better suited for this constrained generative task.
